description: The people of a search by kind: fit («Подходят»: the leads, in their order), partial («Частично»: some requirement not proven, with what was assumed), miss («Не подходят», with the reason). Compact rows; paginate with offset/limit. get_lead gives one person's dossier with facts. [REST: GET /api/tasks/{id}/leads?kind=]

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.
